bio: This collection of former farm buildings is named after the grandmother of the current generation of owners and incorporates a pottery workshop, shop, characterful bedrooms and this homely bistro. The vaulted red-brick ceiling and wood-burning stove give it a rustic feel, while the lovely garden and terrace allow you to soak up the rural peace and quiet. The cooking offers hearty classics such as a full-flavoured bigos with deer and rye bread.
